item.title: DailyFixer 0.1.0
item.description: Tasks that work offline: add a task, tick it off, swipe to delete. Everything is saved on the device first. Mac: one-line install from Terminal into your Applications folder, a DMG for those who prefer it, and updates inside the app (DailyFixer → Check for Updates…), each one checked against our signing key. iPhone and iPad: install and update through SideStore with your own Apple ID (free); our source lists every new version. Google Drive sync (built in, switched on in a later build): each task becomes a small file in DailyFixer's hidden folder in your Drive; the app can't see anything else there. Sign-in appears in Settings once our Google sign-in is set up.
